name: server-vitals
description: Server Vitals — a lightweight host-monitoring agent (not a container). See README.
author: dragonworx
comment: Server Vitals is dependency-free Python; this file exists ONLY so `bun run <name>` can drive the service. Each script wraps the matching Makefile target, which stays the source of truth. No deps, so no `bun install` is needed.
